content: अवदानम् .²1 A pure or approved occupation. .²2 An accomplished act. .²3 A valorous or glorious act, prowess, heroic act, heroism, glorious achievement; संगीयमानत्रिपुरावदानः <ls>Ku. 7. 48</ls>; <ls>Śi. 7. 2</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">18. 16</ls>; प्रापदस्त्रमवदानतोषितात् <ls>R. 11. 21</ls>; <ls>Ki. 17. 16</ls>; तत्त्वत्पूर्वावदानेभ्यो न रोचते <ls>Dk. 52</ls>; <ls>Ki. 3. 43</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">13. 32</ls>. .²4 Object of a legend. .²5 Objection; जुहुयान्मूलमन्त्रेण षोडशर्चावदानतः <ls>Bhāg. 11. 27. 41</ls> Sacrificial object for an oblation.
अवदानम् [अव-दो-ल्युट्] .²1 Cutting or dividing into pieces. .²2 A part, portion; हृदयाद्यवदानानाम् <ls>Ś. B.</ls> .²3 Transgression. .²4 The root of a plant (वीरण); see अवदाह also.
